author: shadowolfyt
body:
Hey Everyone,
This post is for those who are new/existing users to Avicus and need assistance in how to do certain things around our platforms, just helpful videos and tutorials.

Tutorials:
How To: Register your Minecraft Account with TeamSpeak [Added 26th Of May 2017]
How To: Register your Minecraft Account with the Forums [Updated and Readded 27th Of August 2017]
How To: Register your Discord Account with the Forums [Added 27th Of August 2017]

Link to Tutorial Playlist

If you have any suggestions/ideas for a tutorial for new/existing users please put them in the comments of this forum topic.
Please Note: Posts that are not helpful/are not a suggestion will be removed.
